sub_fields.label: Anchor
sub_fields.name: anchorId
sub_fields.instructions: Optional, for links to this section. Saved as a slug of lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens: accented letters become plain ones as the site's language writes them, punctuation is dropped, and spaces, underscores and encoded characters become hyphens. We're hiring gives were-hiring, Straße gives strase (strasse on a German site), contact__form gives contact-form. An anchor that leaves nothing (日本語) counts as none. On the page, an anchor that is one of the landmark ids main, content, header, footer, nav, site-navigation, search or skip-link becomes <anchor>-section, and one an earlier section has taken takes the next free -2, -3. Ids the page draws itself contain __, so they never meet yours. Nothing is added on save. The slug is applied again on the page, to whatever is stored.
